# War Machines music

All four tracks are distributed under the Creative Commons CC0 1.0 public-domain dedication.

- **General — “Robotic City V2”** by Section 31: https://opengameart.org/content/robotic-city-v2
- **Battle — “Final Stand”** by Centurion_of_war: https://opengameart.org/content/final-stand-0
- **Victory — “Cheered On”** by Umplix: https://opengameart.org/content/video-game-music
- **Defeat — “Level Failed”** by Umplix: https://opengameart.org/content/video-game-music

The shipped Ogg Opus files are loudness-normalized and compressed copies of the source files.
